source: Approved decision #10 (result wording for patients) is pending: DRAFT plain-words bands. Never a diagnosis label: say 'mood' and 'worry', never 'depression' or 'anxiety disorder'. The 'What this does not mean' lines are from the tech spec.

bands.negative: Low mood or losing interest in things hasn't bothered you often in the last 2 weeks.
bands.positive: Low mood or losing interest in things has bothered you often in the last 2 weeks.

bands.negative: Feeling nervous or not being able to stop worrying hasn't bothered you often in the last 2 weeks.
bands.positive: Feeling nervous or not being able to stop worrying has bothered you often in the last 2 weeks.

bands.minimal: Your answers show few signs of low mood.
bands.mild: Your answers show some signs of low mood.
bands.moderate: Your answers show a moderate level of low mood.
bands.moderately_severe: Your answers show a high level of low mood.
bands.severe: Your answers show a very high level of low mood.

bands.minimal: Your answers show few signs of worry or nervousness.
bands.mild: Your answers show some signs of worry or nervousness.
bands.moderate: Your answers show a moderate level of worry or nervousness.
bands.severe: Your answers show a high level of worry or nervousness.

doesNotMean: Answers can be affected by sleep, illness or a hard week.
A low score does not mean help is unavailable to you.
fullCheckInOffer: A fuller check-in gives your clinician a clearer picture. It takes about 10 minutes.
